description:
[Servers] Config builder presets, game modes, categories and tag rules. The reference data behind the builder: `presets` (`key`, `label`, `about`, `values` - the settings each one
applies on top of Rust's defaults), `game_modes` (Rust's own modes: `title`, `team_system`, the ConVars each mode
sets at startup in `convars`, and what it `added`/`removed` in words), `categories` (key, label, about),
`startup` (settings that belong on the command line - `server.identity` must), `mode_fixed` (settings a game mode
decides), `dangerous` (settings that break a public server, with why), `tag_groups` + `tag_limit` (the only
server.tags Rust keeps: one per group, at most `tag_limit` groups) and `vanilla_tag_modes` (game modes that keep
the vanilla tag). Presets and Rust's own game modes (softcore, hardcore, primitive...) with the settings each changes.
name: get_server_config_presets
title: Config builder presets, game modes, categories and tag rules
